programme.desc: 不少人未必清楚「日落症候群」與「譫妄」的分別，精神科醫生解釋，前者是通常在下午至傍晚出現的行為及精神症狀，譫妄則屬急性發作的意識及認知紊亂。醫生指兩者皆與認知障礙症相關，並帶來成因與診治資訊。皮膚科醫生指出，疣是由人類乳頭狀病毒(HPV)引起的疾病，並細說常見疣的類別。他強調生疣與否主要視乎個人免疫力及皮膚狀況，另外也會講解珍珠疣及皰疹的相關資訊。「睇餸食飯」，李偉強師傅示範「香蒜牛油煎鮑魚」。

programme.desc: 瑞素搬進張愛盈的單位共同生活，初時未能適應，顯得拘謹。愛盈鼓勵她在家中可自在地做任何事情。其後，璟風發現瑞素因受愛盈影響而有不少改變，更與愛盈經常出入夜店。璟風擔心瑞素會被「帶壞」，遂與凌凌、壯到夜店察看，發現有人疑似在瑞素的飲料下迷藥，璟風出手制止，詎料……最終，瑞素揭示她常到夜店的真正原因，原來另有隱情，並提到與愛盈相處為她帶來不少好處……

programme.desc: 「經珠港飛」首發旅行團陷僵局，日飛靈機一動，提出應變方案，說服雅雯將旅行團改由中衛機場出發……有地勤人員遭旅客襲擊，陳杰冷靜調度監控系統，並迅速協調警方於航班起飛前攔截疑犯。芷珊將調往上海交流，尚偉與勝祥原擔心陳杰難以接受，陳杰卻細心替芷珊備妥生活用品。啟光與可兒駕駛貨機時發現機上疫苗溫度異常，果斷決定折返香港，展開時間競賽……張穎申請轉職地勤獲批，卻意外與同樣被派往海天中轉大樓工作的成軒相遇……

programme.title: 中國建設銀行(亞洲)呈獻：走過歷史大地粵
programme.desc: 樂蜀帝王谷藏着古埃及不少法老的陵墓，近乎完整出土的少年法老圖坦卡門之墓更轟動一時！兩主持「深入」墓地，見證發現黃金面具時刻。文物面世背後不乏神秘色彩，相傳入墓者接連遭「法老的詛咒」；送水男孩是發現陵墓者？以男裝打扮的女法老哈姬蘇，曾在男性統治的古代世界留下光芒印記，其主導的龐特遠征也為古埃及帶來豐富資源，卻遭繼任者試圖抹去「歷史」？尼羅河被視為古埃及的命脈，主持們坐傳統三角帆船遊河，細看箇中意義。

programme.title: 女法醫解密#3粵普PG
programme.desc: 魏言之被捕，證據確鑿令其無法辯駁，他卻毫無悔意。秦府二公子秦隸發現婢女蓮葉屍體，秦莞要求報官，管家劉春卻將其打發走，更一再打斷她在紫竹林的調查。秦莞為秦隸配藥治療楊梅瘡，發現八姨娘的藥方也是治療此病。

programme.title: 東張西望粵

programme.desc: 不少人未必清楚「日落症候群」與「譫妄」的分別，精神科醫生解釋，前者是通常在下午至傍晚出現的行為及精神症狀，譫妄則屬急性發作的意識及認知紊亂。醫生指兩者皆與認知障礙症相關，並帶來成因與診治資訊。皮膚科醫生指出，疣是由人類乳頭狀病毒(HPV)引起的疾病，並細說常見疣的類別。他強調生疣與否主要視乎個人免疫力及皮膚狀況，另外也會講解珍珠疣及皰疹的相關資訊。「睇餸食飯」，李偉強師傅示範「香蒜牛油煎鮑魚」。

programme.title: HOME即是識粵
programme.desc: 用汽球密封水杯，即使倒轉，水亦不會流出？第一條動作題就要進行相關考驗，有藝人臨陣手忙腳亂，不慎打翻水杯！另外，怎樣利用膠水瓶、地拖棍等物品，在伸手不及的高度換燈泡？開展從雪櫃找答案的比拼前，靖韻自言對下廚有信心，最拿手煮「可樂雞翼」，題目卻是關於去除魚腥……搶答回合，問起「FSC認證」會在甚麼材質製成的傢俱上出現？麗珊原來曾修讀環保學科，能否憑相關知識得分？五題過後，某藝人隊暫時竟領先逾千五分！

programme.title: 原來愛上賊#3粵PG
programme.desc: 明翔槍擊譚彬，製造混亂助他離去。江揚以明翔獨特的香水味，查知她對槍械有深厚認識。譚彬在超市巧遇保安主任江翹，江翹請他出讓公仔被拒，糾纏間譚彬不慎毀壞江翹的絕版公仔。江揚發覺明翔乍作不認識喜善妻子陸定虹，查得喜善是集團車手。江翹揭破譚彬以假公仔還給她，譚彬到江翹家偷公仔，發現江揚鎖定明翔及喜善為目標人物。美莉見蓉蓉穿著睡衣在餐廳出入，疑高哲和蓉蓉拍拖，建議江揚偷看高哲的PDA，但被高哲揭發。

programme.title: 高朋滿座#121粵
programme.desc: 大業主兒子威少到藥房宣布全商場即將加租三成，眾人發起反加租抗議行動。威少無故斷水斷電，誓要令慶屈服，慶邀請威少欣賞由高家扮演之街頭劇，威少因怯於記者窮追猛打，私下欲與高慶講和，慶卻當眾撕毀藥房租約。

programme.title: 夢華錄#27粵普PG

programme.title: Sunday靚聲王粵

programme.desc: 慶當眾撕毀藥房的租約，認為公義站在他身旁，喜指責慶苦了家人，因慶竟將藥房的貨物囤積在家。慶不知錯，反在家中「開業」，令高家上下苦不堪言。喜為阻事態惡化，要藥房伙計假裝辭職，再命高麗詐傷，迫慶另覓舖位。

programme.title: 食平D粵
programme.desc: 肥媽以菇類變戲法，尋找隱世的紅菇，據說它有降血壓的妙用。她又以冬菇模仿炒鱔糊，到底如何煮成脆鱔？想煮出香滑的雜菌湯？肥媽有方法。想雜菇飯菇味濃郁，浸過菇的水是關鍵。「大廚平煮」示範平煮蘇州名菜。

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 囤積症是一種精神健康疾病，患者心理上難以捨棄所積存的物件，引致情緒困擾，亦造成環境安全危機。精神科醫生講述箇中成因，並提到與性格有關。醫生提醒若替患者私自執拾，隨時「得不償失」，此話何解？法律援助服務，是確保合資格人士不會因欠缺經濟能力而沒法尋求公義，法援律師細說民事與刑事案件的法援涵蓋範圍。申請人要通過資產及案情審查才會獲批援助，但原來並非絕對免費？「睇餸食飯」，傅季馨炮製「素擔擔涼拌茭白筍」。

programme.title: HOME即是識粵
programme.desc: 繼續搶答題，許靖韻和艾妮隊接連答對，能否殺入最終回合？終極一對一，雙方先平分十個藏有不同金額的寶箱，共四萬元。每題發問前，兩隊要揀出對家的寶箱作為注碼，而先有答題權的隊伍可選擇作答，或由對方去答，答中即搶走對手的寶箱，直至問畢五題，兩隊各得的總獎金才會揭盅！最後一題關於電線接駁，牽涉六個寶箱的歸屬權，某隊竟將答題權給予對家；森美提醒另一隊內有男成員，或對相關知識較熟悉，可會同時將終極勝利送給對方？

programme.title: 原來愛上賊#4粵PG
programme.desc: 江揚調查昔日師傅殉職的銀行劫案，初步認為高哲是兇手。譚彬還不出公仔，欲扮舊病復發撒賴，被江翹揭破；最後譚彬助江翹修復公司電腦保安系統，兩人冰釋前嫌。江揚從喜善留給明翔的假電話號碼中，找出盜賊犯案時間和地點。蓉蓉到美莉工作的銀行見工，得美莉相才獲得取錄。江揚以為明翔及喜善打算安排「黑吃黑」劫案，欲一網打盡，發覺在場的「賊人」統統都是內地高官！原來高哲擺下這個局，希望令江揚被投閒置散。

programme.title: Kiki & Nuna 知識寶庫粵普

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 「WORKOUT 2GETHER」迎來新體適能教練，她會以合氣道方式指引大家做運動。前後腳站好並微蹲，手放腰部，向前行，熟習後可結合手部擺動，甚或跳躍時交換前後腳。完成向前走練習，就試試向後走，一同提升下肢協調度。第二節是下肢肌力訓練，一手握拳伸前，一手打開手掌置胸前，以弓步形式向前走，注意每一步都要同時交換雙手，並做到前腳曲、後腳直。有小朋友短期內未能完全掌握，需教練多番糾正，有甚麼要點？

獵鷹#2粵
programme.desc: 嘉琦在體能測驗時受傷，被振堂處罰。振堂指以嘉琦的成績必須嚴加訓練，大偉決心訓練喜琦。嘉琦與大偉一起返家，見家居被弄至烏煙瘴氣，教訓弟妹一頓，大偉欽佩嘉琦對弟妹的關懷。國基與蓮達等人在學堂酒吧內胡鬧，要大偉帶嘉琦同來，在場人等起哄，令嘉琦尷尬一怒而去。大偉生日，江霞囑約同學吃飯歡聚，大偉欲藉機與嘉琦修好，但嘉琦仍未息怒。振堂讓嘉琦參加野外領導訓練營，但其成績強差人意，嘉琦無奈向振堂提出調職。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 囤積症是一種精神健康疾病，患者心理上難以捨棄所積存的物件，引致情緒困擾，亦造成環境安全危機。精神科醫生講述箇中成因，並提到與性格有關。醫生提醒若替患者私自執拾，隨時「得不償失」，此話何解？法律援助服務，是確保合資格人士不會因欠缺經濟能力而沒法尋求公義，法援律師細說民事與刑事案件的法援涵蓋範圍。申請人要通過資產及案情審查才會獲批援助，但原來並非絕對免費？「睇餸食飯」，傅季馨炮製「素擔擔涼拌茭白筍」。

programme.title: HOME即是識粵
programme.desc: 繼續搶答題，許靖韻和艾妮隊接連答對，能否殺入最終回合？終極一對一，雙方先平分十個藏有不同金額的寶箱，共四萬元。每題發問前，兩隊要揀出對家的寶箱作為注碼，而先有答題權的隊伍可選擇作答，或由對方去答，答中即搶走對手的寶箱，直至問畢五題，兩隊各得的總獎金才會揭盅！最後一題關於電線接駁，牽涉六個寶箱的歸屬權，某隊竟將答題權給予對家；森美提醒另一隊內有男成員，或對相關知識較熟悉，可會同時將終極勝利送給對方？

programme.title: 原來愛上賊#4粵PG
programme.desc: 江揚調查昔日師傅殉職的銀行劫案，初步認為高哲是兇手。譚彬還不出公仔，欲扮舊病復發撒賴，被江翹揭破；最後譚彬助江翹修復公司電腦保安系統，兩人冰釋前嫌。江揚從喜善留給明翔的假電話號碼中，找出盜賊犯案時間和地點。蓉蓉到美莉工作的銀行見工，得美莉相才獲得取錄。江揚以為明翔及喜善打算安排「黑吃黑」劫案，欲一網打盡，發覺在場的「賊人」統統都是內地高官！原來高哲擺下這個局，希望令江揚被投閒置散。

programme.title: 高朋滿座#122粵
programme.desc: 慶當眾撕毀藥房的租約，認為公義站在他身旁，喜指責慶苦了家人，因慶竟將藥房的貨物囤積在家。慶不知錯，反在家中「開業」，令高家上下苦不堪言。喜為阻事態惡化，要藥房伙計假裝辭職，再命高麗詐傷，迫慶另覓舖位。

programme.title: 夢華錄#28粵普PG
programme.desc: 盼兒和千帆路過大橋時，有人故意放了一捆木頭想砸傷他們，千帆以身護著盼兒被木頭砸傷。有人誣衊永安樓送的螃蟹變壞，引章和三娘帶著醫官到現場，證明被人栽贓嫁禍。官家認為千帆偽造夜宴圖，派張允把他帶回去審查。

programme.title: Do姐有問題粵
programme.desc: 原宿色彩繽紛的餐廳，設立目的只為了一位名人？三藩市某餐廳每半小時「天降異象」，令人大驚！韓國集三款口味的長薄餅，可以有多長？楊明、葉翠翠、陳庭欣、黃子恆進行一番運氣大戰，「命水夠好」便能享用法國鵝肝！

programme.title: Do姐有問題粵
programme.desc: 聖地牙哥有餐廳不提供任何餐具，如何盛載食物？經常變形的海腸，應如何處理才可以食用？東京有餐廳以五盅食物作為鎮店之寶，究竟是甚麼平凡食材？Do姐與馬蹄露、袁偉豪及農夫一起憑錦囊猜題，竟顯示出她的高智慧！

programme.title: 味之道
programme.desc: 【《無雙樓》掌廚四大弟子能否化解多年恩怨？】講述廚神秦奮幼年逃避戰亂來到新加坡，艱苦奮鬥後繼承家族餐館「無雙樓」。他收下四名徒弟南花、西紅、東白和北發，並傳授他們各自的獨門廚藝。南花因意外昏迷，餐飲集團「花花食界」由其妻子陳惠瑛掌管，二兒子若風最終成為總裁。為了延續父輩的夢想，若風決心重啟《無雙宴》，但四位師叔的恩怨讓合作變得困難重重。經過不斷的努力與真誠溝通，他逐漸打破了彼此的隔閡，重新喚醒了他們對秦奮的尊敬和對廚藝的熱情。

programme.title: 幽靈醫生
programme.desc: 【傲慢神醫Rain變幽靈，借用死對頭身體熱血救援】擁有神之手的傲慢天才醫生車英民，與含著金湯匙出生卻毫無使命感的臭手住院醫生高勝卓，原本是背景與實力天差地遠的死對頭。然而，一場突如其來的意外，讓英民變成了徘徊醫院的「幽靈」，更不得不附身在他最看不起的勝卓身上！當冷血名醫的靈魂進入笨拙富三代的身體，這對「二合一」的歡喜冤家被迫展開奇妙的共生生活。他們將如何在生死邊緣聯手拯救病患，並在無法離開醫院的命運中，重新領悟醫生的真諦？一場笑中帶淚的奇幻醫療冒險就此展開。

programme.title: 你的世界我們懂
programme.desc: 【2023紅星大獎獲《最佳電視劇》自閉症家庭的家人間扶持/溫馨勵志小品】鄭堅強和李家雲育有三名子女，長女天希，次子天偉，老么天才，一家人和樂融融。雖然天才被確診為自閉症，智能障礙者，家雲工作家庭兩頭忙，但仍努力當個好媽媽。天希跟天偉雖然各有自己的課業與生活，但也從小將照顧弟弟當成自身責任，全家互相扶持。直到有天，媽媽忍著來自公司的壓力，又被太過固執，一再失控的天才給弄得狼狽不堪，當場崩潰，家人們突然發現，沒辦法無時無刻陪在天才左右，天才必須學會獨立與工作，在不斷磨合碰撞下，這家人終於活出喜樂的一片天~

programme.title: 白夜童話(完)
programme.desc: 【《紳士與小姐》朴荷娜演技狂飆復仇拋夫棄子生母】從小遭母親拋棄，加上父親早逝，白夜與哥哥相依為命，性格堅強好勝的她總對哥哥百般依賴，也因嫉妒哥哥與大嫂的好感情，生活中常常刁難懷孕的大嫂，搞得哥哥十分頭疼。某天哥哥與生母連絡上，面對母親拒絕相認，哥哥內心大受打擊，一晃神就因交通意外不幸離世，得知此事的白夜便將所有憤怒轉向母親，展開一系列的報復計畫。

programme.title: 不屈的兒媳
programme.desc: 【三百年宗族危機寡媳愛上財團之子】擁有三百年歷史的宗族大家庭「滿月堂」，卻深陷男人短命、香火將斷的宿命。長孫媳吳英心與丈夫結婚十年始終未能生育，卻在丈夫驟逝後被迫守寡；另一孫媳慧媛則遭丈夫拋棄。家族愁雲慘霧之際，愛情卻悄然來臨，兩位孫媳分別愛上財團之子，就連守節多年的婆婆也動了凡心。當傳統與情感正面衝突，滿月堂的女人們，究竟該守著祖訓終老，還是勇敢追求屬於自己的幸福？

programme.title: 不像三兄弟
programme.desc: 【李浚赫化身金家小兒子婆媳兵團VS警察家族笑料不斷！】聚焦警察爸爸金巡警的三個兒子，廢柴長子安內相被期待壓垮，一事無成卻偷偷戀上單親媽媽；事業型二哥吳大奎功成名就，卻被夾在母親偏心與妻子不滿之間，婚姻岌岌可危；理想派小兒子李浚赫剛當警察，卻愛上了脾氣火爆的富家女。兄弟情誼充滿矛盾和心結，當愛情遭遇現實考驗，婆媳摩擦與婚姻裂痕不斷升級，這個家不再是避風港，而是情緒的火藥庫。笑中帶淚的家庭日常，揭開最真實又狗血的親情與愛情試煉！

programme.title: 味之道
programme.desc: 【《無雙樓》掌廚四大弟子能否化解多年恩怨？】講述廚神秦奮幼年逃避戰亂來到新加坡，艱苦奮鬥後繼承家族餐館「無雙樓」。他收下四名徒弟南花、西紅、東白和北發，並傳授他們各自的獨門廚藝。南花因意外昏迷，餐飲集團「花花食界」由其妻子陳惠瑛掌管，二兒子若風最終成為總裁。為了延續父輩的夢想，若風決心重啟《無雙宴》，但四位師叔的恩怨讓合作變得困難重重。經過不斷的努力與真誠溝通，他逐漸打破了彼此的隔閡，重新喚醒了他們對秦奮的尊敬和對廚藝的熱情。

programme.title: 幽靈醫生
programme.desc: 【傲慢神醫Rain變幽靈，借用死對頭身體熱血救援】擁有神之手的傲慢天才醫生車英民，與含著金湯匙出生卻毫無使命感的臭手住院醫生高勝卓，原本是背景與實力天差地遠的死對頭。然而，一場突如其來的意外，讓英民變成了徘徊醫院的「幽靈」，更不得不附身在他最看不起的勝卓身上！當冷血名醫的靈魂進入笨拙富三代的身體，這對「二合一」的歡喜冤家被迫展開奇妙的共生生活。他們將如何在生死邊緣聯手拯救病患，並在無法離開醫院的命運中，重新領悟醫生的真諦？一場笑中帶淚的奇幻醫療冒險就此展開。

programme.title: 你的世界我們懂
programme.desc: 【2023紅星大獎獲《最佳電視劇》自閉症家庭的家人間扶持/溫馨勵志小品】鄭堅強和李家雲育有三名子女，長女天希，次子天偉，老么天才，一家人和樂融融。雖然天才被確診為自閉症，智能障礙者，家雲工作家庭兩頭忙，但仍努力當個好媽媽。天希跟天偉雖然各有自己的課業與生活，但也從小將照顧弟弟當成自身責任，全家互相扶持。直到有天，媽媽忍著來自公司的壓力，又被太過固執，一再失控的天才給弄得狼狽不堪，當場崩潰，家人們突然發現，沒辦法無時無刻陪在天才左右，天才必須學會獨立與工作，在不斷磨合碰撞下，這家人終於活出喜樂的一片天~

programme.title: 不像三兄弟
programme.desc: 【李浚赫化身金家小兒子婆媳兵團VS警察家族笑料不斷！】聚焦警察爸爸金巡警的三個兒子，廢柴長子安內相被期待壓垮，一事無成卻偷偷戀上單親媽媽；事業型二哥吳大奎功成名就，卻被夾在母親偏心與妻子不滿之間，婚姻岌岌可危；理想派小兒子李浚赫剛當警察，卻愛上了脾氣火爆的富家女。兄弟情誼充滿矛盾和心結，當愛情遭遇現實考驗，婆媳摩擦與婚姻裂痕不斷升級，這個家不再是避風港，而是情緒的火藥庫。笑中帶淚的家庭日常，揭開最真實又狗血的親情與愛情試煉！

programme.title: 不屈的兒媳
programme.desc: 【三百年宗族危機寡媳愛上財團之子】擁有三百年歷史的宗族大家庭「滿月堂」，卻深陷男人短命、香火將斷的宿命。長孫媳吳英心與丈夫結婚十年始終未能生育，卻在丈夫驟逝後被迫守寡；另一孫媳慧媛則遭丈夫拋棄。家族愁雲慘霧之際，愛情卻悄然來臨，兩位孫媳分別愛上財團之子，就連守節多年的婆婆也動了凡心。當傳統與情感正面衝突，滿月堂的女人們，究竟該守著祖訓終老，還是勇敢追求屬於自己的幸福？

programme.title: 不像三兄弟

programme.desc: 【《無雙樓》掌廚四大弟子能否化解多年恩怨？】講述廚神秦奮幼年逃避戰亂來到新加坡，艱苦奮鬥後繼承家族餐館「無雙樓」。他收下四名徒弟南花、西紅、東白和北發，並傳授他們各自的獨門廚藝。南花因意外昏迷，餐飲集團「花花食界」由其妻子陳惠瑛掌管，二兒子若風最終成為總裁。為了延續父輩的夢想，若風決心重啟《無雙宴》，但四位師叔的恩怨讓合作變得困難重重。經過不斷的努力與真誠溝通，他逐漸打破了彼此的隔閡，重新喚醒了他們對秦奮的尊敬和對廚藝的熱情。

programme.title: 你的世界我們懂
programme.desc: 【2023紅星大獎獲《最佳電視劇》自閉症家庭的家人間扶持/溫馨勵志小品】鄭堅強和李家雲育有三名子女，長女天希，次子天偉，老么天才，一家人和樂融融。雖然天才被確診為自閉症，智能障礙者，家雲工作家庭兩頭忙，但仍努力當個好媽媽。天希跟天偉雖然各有自己的課業與生活，但也從小將照顧弟弟當成自身責任，全家互相扶持。直到有天，媽媽忍著來自公司的壓力，又被太過固執，一再失控的天才給弄得狼狽不堪，當場崩潰，家人們突然發現，沒辦法無時無刻陪在天才左右，天才必須學會獨立與工作，在不斷磨合碰撞下，這家人終於活出喜樂的一片天~

programme.title: 不像三兄弟
programme.desc: 【李浚赫化身金家小兒子婆媳兵團VS警察家族笑料不斷！】聚焦警察爸爸金巡警的三個兒子，廢柴長子安內相被期待壓垮，一事無成卻偷偷戀上單親媽媽；事業型二哥吳大奎功成名就，卻被夾在母親偏心與妻子不滿之間，婚姻岌岌可危；理想派小兒子李浚赫剛當警察，卻愛上了脾氣火爆的富家女。兄弟情誼充滿矛盾和心結，當愛情遭遇現實考驗，婆媳摩擦與婚姻裂痕不斷升級，這個家不再是避風港，而是情緒的火藥庫。笑中帶淚的家庭日常，揭開最真實又狗血的親情與愛情試煉！

programme.title: 幽靈醫生
programme.desc: 【傲慢神醫Rain變幽靈，借用死對頭身體熱血救援】擁有神之手的傲慢天才醫生車英民，與含著金湯匙出生卻毫無使命感的臭手住院醫生高勝卓，原本是背景與實力天差地遠的死對頭。然而，一場突如其來的意外，讓英民變成了徘徊醫院的「幽靈」，更不得不附身在他最看不起的勝卓身上！當冷血名醫的靈魂進入笨拙富三代的身體，這對「二合一」的歡喜冤家被迫展開奇妙的共生生活。他們將如何在生死邊緣聯手拯救病患，並在無法離開醫院的命運中，重新領悟醫生的真諦？一場笑中帶淚的奇幻醫療冒險就此展開。

programme.title: 不屈的兒媳
programme.desc: 【三百年宗族危機寡媳愛上財團之子】擁有三百年歷史的宗族大家庭「滿月堂」，卻深陷男人短命、香火將斷的宿命。長孫媳吳英心與丈夫結婚十年始終未能生育，卻在丈夫驟逝後被迫守寡；另一孫媳慧媛則遭丈夫拋棄。家族愁雲慘霧之際，愛情卻悄然來臨，兩位孫媳分別愛上財團之子，就連守節多年的婆婆也動了凡心。當傳統與情感正面衝突，滿月堂的女人們，究竟該守著祖訓終老，還是勇敢追求屬於自己的幸福？

programme.title: You Cant Win Em All
programme.desc: As the Ottoman Empire collapses throughout Turkey in 1922, a number of adventurers from all over the world sign on to protect the locals from thieves and marauders--for a hefty price. Two such mercenaries are Adam and Josh, who are hired by provincial Turkish governor Osman. Adam and Josh are expected to protect their boss' gold shipment, and to provide safe conduct for Osman Bey's three daughters. Along the way, our 'heroes' decide to forget their mission and abscond with the gold, but their plans are foiled by their own inherent ineptitude--and by the bothersome interference of duplicitous Colonel Elci.

programme.desc: A German hermit, who can talk with worms, seeks revenge on the town's mayor by putting mutant worms in everyone's meals and turning them into human worm slaves.

programme.desc: Rookie is sitting on the shore, enjoying the sun, when he sees something repeatedly poking out of the water, sparking his curiosity. He puts on his underwater robot mask and dives into the ocean. At first, all he finds are rocks and coral, but suddenly, big, round eyes are staring at him from a gray rock. He flees in panic, but when he realizes that it is an octopus whose tentacles are tangled in plastic waste, he quickly frees his new friend from this unpleasant situation, and they dance happily together in the water

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - GAME ON? ROOKIE AND THE COMPUTER
programme.desc: Rookie comes across an office cubicle with a computer on the table and is immediately fascinated. He presses some keys, a little character appears on the screen, and a computer game starts. Very excited, Rookie continues to press different keys. When in the end he wins the race and earns a trophy, the computer suddenly takes Rookie‘s photo and prints it out. However, the printing doesn‘t stop, and soon the whole floor is covered with photos before Rookie finally manages to shut down the computer and stop the madness.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - LET IT BEEEEE! ROOKIE AND THE BEE
programme.desc: Rookie finds a wooden box, knocks on it, and then shakes it. What a bad idea! The whole swarm of bees chases him, and he has to hide in the bushes. After the swarm is gone, he finds a tired and exhausted bee on the ground. Rookie has the idea to rescue the little bee with a sugar cube. The whole beehive is grateful, and Rookie learns a lot about the work of these useful little friends.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - SNOWBALL EFFECT? ROOKIE AND THE POLAR BEAR
programme.desc: Rookie is happily stomping through the snow when he suddenly gets hit by several snowballs. A pair of cheeky polar bears try to engage him in a playful snowball fight. But Rookie outwits them by hiding in the snow, causing the bears to stumble and then get hit by his surprise robot snowball machine. After the snowy confusion turns to laughter, everyone shares a moment of fun and happiness.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - SPRING, SUMMER, FALL & WINTER - ROOKIE AND THE 4 SEASONS
programme.desc: From the window of his house Rookie watches the four seasons pass by and thinks of his friends and the great fun and adventures they had throughout the year: The bees that make everything bloom and the cheeky little ladybug in spring; a day at the beach, snorkeling with friends and a water battle in summer; fl ying kites, fun in the rain and his friend the squirrel getting ready in autumn and building snowmen, snowballs and sledding fun in winter.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - READY, SET, GO! ROOKIE AND THE RABBIT
programme.desc: Rookie is relaxing in the sun when something rushes past him, leaving him in a cloud of dust. Using his telescope, he spots a racing rabbit, and with the tasty prospect of a sweet carrot for the winner, he manages to persuade it to take part in a race. Ready – steady – and off they go: Even though the rabbit stumbles and Rookie has to help, they finish the race together, tumbling happily over the finish line.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - BALANCE IN PINK – ROOKIE AND THE FLAMINGO
programme.desc: On his stroll around a lake, Rookie spots a group of pink flamingos gracefully balancing on one leg. Curious, Rookie tries to imitate them and, after practicing a little, manages to do so quite well. But suddenly there‘s a loud splash and Rookie discovers a flamingo struggling to stand on one leg, falling over and over. Offering to help, Rookie comes up with an excellent idea - a pair of roller skates! And there, slowly but surely, the flamingo learns to skate gracefully like a ballerina and to balance on one leg as well.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - BOUNCE, REBOUND - SCORE! ROOKIE AND THE GIRAFFE
programme.desc: Rookie is out for a walk on a beautiful day when he suddenly hears a rhythmic sound in the distance. Curious as always, he goes out to investigate and finds a young giraffe playing basketball, skillfully dribbling and bouncing the ball into a basketball hoop high in the trees. Of course, Rookie wants to join in, but he has a few things to learn before their first game. In the end, they impress each other with their skills and tricks.

programme.title: Asia S01 - The Arid Heart
programme.desc: In the heart of Asia lie vast arid lands. These deserts and dry grasslands are so hostile, they push life to the limit. Here, one of the rarest animals on earth, the Gobi Bear, searches desperately for water and bizarre looking long-eared Jerboas use their striking features to catch prey. On the arid grasslands, Pallas Cats need ingenious ways to get close to their prey, Mongolian Gazelles must battle harsh winters and human barriers, and Takhi are terrorised each night by Mongolian wolves.

programme.title: Joanna Lumley's Spice Trail Adventure S01 - Madagascar
programme.desc: Joanna Lumley's spice journey continues on the African island of Madagascar. Travelling overland on the country's notorious pot-holed roads, she discovers the secrets of the world's second most expensive spice, vanilla. From the unique way it's grown to how it's dealt on the streets. She searches for gold with a poor gold-mining community and finds out how cacao is used to make some of the world's best chocolate.

programme.title: The Shepherd Girl
programme.desc: In this musical drama, Hsiu Hsiu, a beautiful shepherd girl, falls in love with a handsome boatman Ta Lung. To complicate the matter, a rival suitor promises to pay off all her father's debts on one condition: that Hsiu Hsiu marries him...

programme.title: The Tigress Of Shaolin
programme.desc: Sam is being hunted as he discovers that the mayor and the chief of medical bureau are colluding with a drug dealer. He is saved by a fishermen family and works in their friend's grocery but the grocery owner is killed when the enemies track Sam down. Sam escapes to Shaolin to learn the cudgel style of kung fu in order to avenge his friends.

programme.title: The Emperor and the Minister
programme.desc: The ingenious imperial scholar Liu Yung always embarrasses Emperor Chien Lung with his quick wit and gift of gab. The emperor purposely sets him up to solve the seemingly unsolvable. However, Liu Yung resolves it easily with wit and style and foils the emperor's plot once again.

programme.title: The Singing Killer
programme.desc: Chiang Yi is blackmailed into a jewellery heist by his former boss who threatens to expose his shady past. Complications arise when Chiang Yi discovers his first love working in the jewellery store.

programme.title: Notorious Eight
programme.desc: The young Chen Chi-chin (Liu Yung) loses heavily to experienced gambler Hu Kuan-ten (Lo Lieh). His father loses at cards and dies of shock. Chen appeals to his uncle who summons seven fellow professional gamblers to carry out vengeance. Much more than a gambling film, this is a thrilling melting pot of martial arts stars, extortion, illicit love, poker-face vengeance, and all sorts of edge-of-your-seat gambling duels.

programme.title: Crazy Shaolin Disciples
programme.desc: The story revolves around three lay disciples of the Shaolin Temple: Fang Shi Yu, Hong Xi Guan, and Hu Hui Qian. Monk Jie instructs them in martial arts, but their frequent competitions with fellow disciple Wu Qing spark rivalries. The once serene Shaolin Temple is plunged into chaos, yet even the abbot cannot help but be amused by their antics.

programme.title: Rendezvous With Death
programme.desc: Sun Chung had been recognized as an expert comedy and crime thriller director, but he was to gain even greater acclaim for his soulful, powerful, intelligent, and beautifully-made martial arts epics. This stands alongside The Deadly Breaking Sword and The Kung-fu Instructor as one of his very best.

programme.title: The Crimson Palm
programme.desc: Poor student Lin is engaged to the daughter of a rich man who despises him because of his family's declining status. Lin visits his fiancée before leaving for the Imperial examination, but finds a maid lying dead in blood. As Lin's bloody handprint is left on the site, he is accused of the murder. How can Justice Bao prove his innocence?

programme.title: Murder Plot
programme.desc: Martial artist Shen Lang is in discussions with kung fu experts from the other six sects to plot the downfall of the traitorous Happy King when his fiancée suddenly disrupts them and Shen has to quickly bring her away. As they continue to pursue the Happy King, both Shen and his fiancée accidentally fall into a trap set up by the King.

programme.title: The Comedy of Mismatches
programme.desc: Two pairs of lovers got mismatched accidentally. The man disguises as a woman for his sister's wedding ceremony, while his lover disguises as a man to marry another woman. After the marriage mismatches are revealed, the lovers and their families are taken to court, where Prefecture Chief Qiao manages to work out a happy ending.

programme.title: The Condemned
programme.desc: Feng, a homeless man, is wrongly accused of robbery and subsequently arrested and imprisoned. The actual bandit bribes fellow inmate Yang, a pickpocket, to kill Feng. Aware of Feng's innocence, Yang resolves to help him escape from prison. However, their escape attempt goes awry, and both find themselves facing the grim reality of death row.

programme.title: The Monkey Goes West
programme.desc: Adapted from the classic Chinese novel of the same title, the story follows Monk Tang San Zang's journey to the West in search of the Buddhist Sutra. On the way, he encounters and takes as disciples, Monkey, Pigsy and Sha Wu Jing.

programme.title: My Rebellious Son
programme.desc: A corrupt official attempts to steal a priceless Buddha statue from a temple to please a group of Westerners. Luckily, Doctor Zhang and his son manage to defeat the Western boxers, the Japanese Kendo opponents and the Western longsword fighters with Chinese kung fu, thus saving the Buddha statue.

programme.title: Scandal
programme.desc: The roguish scamp Zhen and his best friend Chia collects proof of corruption from the officials in this comedy-drama. After a string of blackmailing, they end up in positions of power, but what is to happen next?

programme.title: Village of Tigers
programme.desc: The devilish residents of the Village of Tigers, led by Hu Jiao, plan to kill Lo Hong Shun, otherwise known as the heroic Sword of the Southern Sky. Hu Jiao sees a way to use the righteousness of the honorable Ba family to help him kill the hero Lo by turning them against him. Will good prevail over evil?

programme.title: Village of Tigers
programme.desc: The devilish residents of the Village of Tigers, led by Hu Jiao, plan to kill Lo Hong Shun, otherwise known as the heroic Sword of the Southern Sky. Hu Jiao sees a way to use the righteousness of the honorable Ba family to help him kill the hero Lo by turning them against him. Will good prevail over evil?

programme.title: Beyond the Great Wall
programme.desc: Wang Zhao Jun refuses to bribe the imperial painter, so he draws an ugly portrait of her, preventing her from being selected by the Emperor until they meet in person. The painter ends up in exile and plots for Wang to marry the Hun's warlord as a revenge. The Emperor rejects this, provoking a war which is only averted when Wang sacrifices herself.

programme.title: Swordsman at Large
programme.desc: Hsiao Shi Yi Lang is the Swordsman at large who everyone wants to kill. A magnificient sword is even created for this purpose though the blade is soon coveted more than the swordsman's death by it! Bandits, beauties and blade masters battle for survival in this exciting story of deceit, betrayal, and death.

programme.title: Facets Of Love
programme.desc: Set in the Ming Dynasty, the story revolves around a brothel and the girls who work there. The film begins by following the life of a girl from a poor family, who is sold by her mother to the brothel. While she is the most beautiful of the girls and attracts many clients, the girl hopes to escape this sad way of life one day.

programme.title: Wits Of The Brats
programme.desc: Tou Kuan is a wealthy Kwangtung brat with a good kung fu background, he has only one ambition: to pit his wits against three shady masters of the North. The first, conman Che Tsai. The second, a professional romantic dubbed The Terrific. Terrific introduces Tou Kuan to his third rival, Thief Shih San-shou.

programme.title: The Thundering Sword
programme.desc: Two disciples, Yu and Zheng, are sent by their master to track down the invincible weapon "Thundering Sword" to prevent villains from getting it. Yu encounters the daughter of a ruthless clan, Chiao, who is on her way to seek for the sword. They quickly fall for each other, but when Chiao accidentally injures Zheng, things become complicated.

programme.title: Call of the Sea
programme.desc: A young fisherman, Chin Hu is in love with his childhood friend Hsiao Yu. However, the only son of a town bully lusts after Hsiao Yu's beauty and tries all possible ways to approach her. Chin Hu protects another woman from the bully one day, leading Hsiao Yu to misunderstand him and suspect that they are having an affair...

programme.title: Iron Bodyguard
programme.desc: Wang Wu, the head of a security firm Iron Bodyguard, meets a scholar who is a member of the Reformists, a group of scholars pressing for social reform in China at the end of the Qing dynasty. The Emperor actually supports such reforms but not the Empress Dowager. She orders the Reformists to be arrested and Wang Wu gets drawn into the politics.

programme.title: The Pure and the Evil
programme.desc: Two teen girls, Rose and May, become close friends despite their different social backgrounds. The rich girl May moves to America but returns years later to see Rose, now a beauty queen and bar girl. Rose is immediately attracted to Fang's fiancé and their relationship quickly deteriorates when Rose sets out to pursue him…

programme.title: The Duel
programme.desc: After knowing his brother has killed the head of a rival triad, Jie takes the blame and was hunted by killers. With the help of Rambler Nan, Jie finally killed his enemies, but then found out that Nan is the one who has killed his father.

programme.title: Challenge of the Gamesters
programme.desc: A master gambler and his partner are recruited to investigate a Shanghai tycoon suspected of using his casino as a front for espionage. As they enter the high-stakes gambling world, they must outwit a dangerous opponent in a deadly game of skill and deception.

programme.title: The Master
programme.desc: Gao Jian is the disciple of the martial arts master Shi but is constantly being punished by his master for no reason. One day, Gao accidentally saves his master's rival Jin, so Jin teaches him his unique martial arts skill in return. However, Master Shi sees this as Gao's betrayal…

programme.title: We Love Millionaires
programme.desc: In this romantic comedy, three beautiful Hong Kong salesgirls travel to Osaka in Japan to pursue their dreams of marrying a rich man. They masquerade as high society debutantes and make their way to a posh resort to meet and woo millionaires (or fake ones!).

programme.title: Shaolin Prince
programme.desc: After a royal coup, two princes are separated, one raised in Shaolin as Dao Xing, the other as Wu Zi Tai under a minister. Years later, they meet at Shaolin while seeking the Yi Jin Jing, unaware they are brothers, as hidden identities and destiny unfold amid rising conflict and danger.

programme.title: Sweet And Wild
programme.desc: Fang is a spunky young village girl who is not afraid to fight back against hooligans. She gets into trouble with the biggest hoodlum Tong when she foils his plans with a maid, causing Tong to plot a revenge. Luckily a man whom she is attracted to, Hai, comes in time to her rescue. Can they fight back?

programme.title: Sweet And Wild
programme.desc: Fang is a spunky young village girl who is not afraid to fight back against hooligans. She gets into trouble with the biggest hoodlum Tong when she foils his plans with a maid, causing Tong to plot a revenge. Luckily a man whom she is attracted to, Hai, comes in time to her rescue. Can they fight back?

programme.title: Dragon Swamp
programme.desc: Fan is cheated by her lover Tong to steal her master's Jade Dragon Sword. She is jailed in the Dragon Swamp as punishment and gave birth to a pair of twins - her daughter is raised by her master, while her son is taken by Tong. Twenty years later, the sword is stolen again and Fan's daughter goes seeking for it, meeting Fan's friend along the way.

programme.title: Moods Of Love
programme.desc: This Song Dynasty period piece about how far one would go for love (or lust) has two tales. The first involves a devilish magistrate who tries to tempt a Buddhist monk out of his self-professed celibacy by hiring a pretty prostitute. The second is the tragic tale of an exploited young girl who is forced to work in an unscrupulous couple's brothel.

programme.title: Raw Passions
programme.desc: Mrs Lin's husband and his friend both have affairs with a belly dancer Sasa, and are both blackmailed by her. Sasa is stabbed one day and her brother shows up asking for money. A mysterious man also claims he can offer evidence for cash to help Lin's husband. Lin has to unveil the deceit, double-crosses and blackmailing before she is in danger too!

programme.title: Hex
programme.desc: This supernatural mystery tells the story of a sickly wife and her maid conspiring to kill her beastly husband, leading to a string of events with spooky twists and turns.

programme.title: Empress Wu
programme.desc: Wu Ze Tian is a beautiful and talented concubine of Emperor Tang at age 14. She becomes a nun after he died but has two sons with the new Emperor Tang Gao Zong. The Empress asks Wu to team up with her against Consort Xiao, but is set up and dethroned by Wu, who also kills her two sons. After the Emperor's death, Wu becomes the first woman Emperor.

programme.title: Rolls, Rolls, I Love You
programme.desc: Three young men offend a billionaire and are drawn into a high stakes bet. If they win, they get to keep the billionaire's Rolls Royce. Otherwise, they will need to pay the rich man fifty thousand dollars! Will the underdogs win the bet?

programme.title: Love without End
programme.desc: In this classic romantic melodrama, nightclub songstress Qing Qing falls for the handsome Peng Nan. However, the two go through an emotional roller coaster of misunderstandings, separations and mutual torment. When the two finally fall back into love, Qing Qing receives a shocking revelation that brings the story to its inevitable sad ending.

programme.title: Pursuit of Vengeance
programme.desc: Kung Fu legend Ti Lung stars in the action movie as Fu Xue Hong, embarking on a epic journey of revenge for his father.

programme.title: Return of the Crazy Bumpkins
programme.desc: This sequel makes for more bittersweet laughs and heart-wrenching misfortune, as Ah Niu gets out of the jail to find his true love becoming the wife of an abusive husband, and his uncle further exploits his naive nature.

programme.title: Heroes Of Sung
programme.desc: Heroes Of Sung stars one of the original kung fu ladies of the silver screen, Shih Szu, who plays swordswoman Meng Hung. She must work with Fan Tien-Fu, played by Lo Lieh to find and protect the royal seals of the Sung Dynasty. Shih's magnificent performance earned her the female hero role in another hit Dracula And The 7 Golden Vampires.

programme.title: The Voyage of Emperor Chien Lung
programme.desc: Emperor Chien Lung continues his incognito voyage to southern China. Accompanied by the minister and the imperial scholar, they have many amusing encounters in Yangzhou.

programme.title: The Lady Assassin
programme.desc: Two feuding princes fight for the throne in the Qing Dynasty, causing many injuries and deaths to the commoners. Can the lady assassin who is drawn into this royal feud execute her assassination mission in time to help one of the princes secure the throne?

programme.title: Rose, Be My Love
programme.desc: Not a love triangle but a love 'rectangle', Rose, Be My Love is a romantic drama set on the eve of World War II that represents the high standards achieved by Shaw Brothers in both aspects of star power and technical polish.

programme.title: Gambler's Delight
programme.desc: The Killer star Danny Lee plays the lead role of a guy who needs to become a hero. He lies, steals and cheats his way into operating a plush casino, but when he incurs the wrath of a female Japanese gang leader, all bets are off!

programme.title: The Lost Bladesman
programme.desc: An epic historic adventure set during the turbulent times of the Three Kingdoms. Cao Cao attempts to enlist Guan Yu into his forces, but Guan is loyal to his sworn brother Liu Bei, who is also Cao's enemy. As Guan tries to rescue Liu Bei's concubine from Cao, he is forced to fight his way through. Can he succeed in the end?

programme.title: Green Wood Robbery
programme.desc: Set in the early years of the Republic of China, the wealthy Kang family is brutally murdered, and their young daughter -the sole witness- mysteriously disappears. For decades, the haunting of the Kang house on Green Wood Lane lingers. As the truth behind the tragedy unfolds, motives of revenge and death intertwine in this chilling mystery.

programme.title: Royal Tramp II
programme.desc: The leader of Dragon clan, Long Er, helps General Wu to overthrow Emperor Kang Xi. However, Long Er is betrayed by General Wu and is rescued by Xiao Bao. As a result, she bestows her virginity and martial arts power to Xiao Bao to fight against Wu. At the same time, Xiao Bao fortuitously unveils the hidden treasures from "The Sutra of 42 Chapters".

programme.title: Lost Memories
programme.desc: As a young mother grapples with her daughter's mysterious disappearance, a series of eerie events unfold. These events could be linked to the vengeful ghosts of a tragic accident that happened 20 years ago...

programme.title: King Of Beggars
programme.desc: So was born a nobleman but is relegated to a beggar after being caught cheating. He becomes the chief of the Beggar's gang when he saves the gang's elder. One day, So foils an assassination attempt on the Emperor and is allowed to reinstate his status but he declines. He is then rewarded with an imperial beggar bowl and lives happily ever after.

programme.title: Chinese Odyssey2-Cinderella
programme.desc: Following the chaos unleashed by Pandora's Box, Joker is thrust through time and begins to awaken as the Monkey King, Sun Wukong. Torn between mortal emotions and divine destiny, he struggles to reconcile his love for Zixia Fairy with the responsibilities of his past.

programme.title: Women
programme.desc: Bo Yi's husband is having an affair, so Bo Yi divorces him and joins the "Happy Spinsters Club" set up by her friends. However, she soon finds out that she does not enjoy being single and while sorting out her thoughts, her repentant husband begs her forgiveness. She must now decide on what she truly wants.

programme.title: The Comeback
programme.desc: Uncle Hua is a retired agent who owns an antique shop on an old street. When the old street is forcibly demolished by the local Green Dragon Gang one day, Uncle Hua's hidden identity is accidentally revealed, and he is pursued by a mysterious organization headed by Ah Jie. A fatal duel has just begun!

programme.title: Ghost Wedding
programme.desc: Photographer Zhi Cheng is entangled with a "woman in red", leading to the deaths of his relatives one by one. When the girl he likes, Si Tong, also dies mysteriously, Zhi Cheng vows to find out the truth but ends up revealing the secret of a "ghost marriage"...

programme.title: Wusong VS Ximenqing
programme.desc: Wu Song finds out about his sister-in-law's affair with a rich man, Ximen Qing. Qing sets Song up and have him exiled for a year, during which his hapless brother is murdered and cremated. When Song finally returns home, he takes the case to court but the judge brushes it aside and closes it abruptly. Can Song finally avenge his brother's death?

programme.title: Fierce Cop
programme.desc: To save his son who has been kidnapped by human traffickers, police officer Zhang relentlessly hunts them down and accidentally finds himself implicated in a major child abduction case. In the process, he teams up with a mysterious lady to crack the international crime syndicate and rescue his son.

programme.title: Kungfu Stuntmen
programme.desc: Hong Kong action cinema is famous for its real kung fu moves performed by a group called "Kung Fu Stuntmen". This docu-film pays tribute to the generations of kung fu stuntmen, with the crew spending over two years digging archives and interviewing many talents, including the most prominent masters like Jackie Chan, Donnie Yen and Sammo Hung.

programme.title: Girl with the Diamond Slipper
programme.desc: An aspiring TV actress gets into hot water when a stolen diamond is hidden in the shoes she bought for a party.

programme.title: The Bare-footed Kid
programme.desc: A poor, bare-footed young man from the countryside arrives in the city to work with the friend of his dead father. When their dye shop is burnt down by a local strongman, he decides to fight back to protect all of them and save the shop.

programme.title: Oily Maniac
programme.desc: Famous director Ho Meng-hua, who gave Jackie Chan and Sammo Hung acting breaks in his early kung-fu films, broke new ground with his horror hit Oily Maniac. Based on a true story about a creature that kills people at night and covers them in oil, it stars young actor Danny Lee (aka. Li Hsiu-hsien) as the oily maniac. It was considered so scary that it was censored drastically.

programme.title: Whatever You Want
programme.desc: An illegitimate daughter of a businessman gets three wishes from a genie, Bo. However, Bo's magical power is far from perfect, leading to much hilarity in this charming fantasy comedy.

programme.title: Whatever You Want
programme.desc: An illegitimate daughter of a businessman gets three wishes from a genie, Bo. However, Bo's magical power is far from perfect, leading to much hilarity in this charming fantasy comedy.

programme.title: Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon
programme.desc: The legendary swordsman Li, entrusts the Green Destiny sword to a noble house for safekeeping. It is swiftly stolen by Yu, a young aristocrat of immense martial skills trained by an unscrupulous outlaw master. Recognising her talent, Li tries to guide her towards righteousness but ultimately leads them both to a tragic fate.

programme.title: Detrimental
programme.desc: You Ji Ren is a blind man who works at a factory on an outlying island. When the factory is cut off from the outside world by a hurricane one day, a monster appears and turns whoever sees it into black shadows. As You cannot see the monster, he is able to help his other co-workers escape safely and fight to kill the monster.

programme.title: Iceman
programme.desc: Falsely accused of murder, Ming Dynasty Imperial Guard Ying is pursued by his three sworn brothers until a fierce battle leaves all four entombed in ice. Four hundred years later, they awaken in modern Hong Kong, where they must reignite their ancient feud in a world they can barely recognise.

programme.title: Impermanence
programme.desc: A series of strange events is happening in a peaceful village, including a corpse that is resurrected from its grave and ran away. As the villagers investigate, a villain dies and the village head also goes missing. Police investigation ensues, but as the truths start to unveil, more mysteries are unfolding. Who is the one behind them all?

programme.title: When Fortune Smiles
programme.desc: A rich man dies, leaving all his fortune to his daughter in his will, but his son and nephew want a piece of the pie. The nephew sends Vincent to steal the will and the son finds Fung, who looks like his sister, to get the will. Vincent plans to marry Fung for the fortune, but as the two fall in love, they decide to unveil the cunning schemes.

programme.title: The Grey Men 2
programme.desc: Triad boss Song seeks to whitewash his image and seize Laika's mayoral seat amid a regime change. He faces a funding shortfall despite colluding with officials, and gets his right-hand man and enforcer to commit crimes to boost his funds and power. Just as Song believes success is imminent, the dynamics between the three take an unexpected turn...

programme.title: Fight Back to School II
programme.desc: Following his demotion, officer Sing resigns from the police force and goes undercover at an international school to privately investigate a terrorist plot. There, he discovers bumbling detective Tat posing as a teacher. Forced into an alliance, they team up to confront the heavily armed criminals behind the plot in a chaotic showdown.

programme.title: Behind the Yellow Line
programme.desc: A fresh graduate, Paul, strikes up an acquaintance with a pretty young girl, Monica, on the metro. Monica is involved in a love affair with a married man while Paul is also pursued by a rich girl. When Paul vows his true love for Monica, she suggests playing hide-and-seek with him in the metro to decide if they are fated to be together.

programme.title: Love on Delivery
programme.desc: A delivery boy Yin wants to impress his dream girl Li, so he enrols in a martial arts course to learn strange moves. Being timid, Yin saves Li while wearing a Garfield mask but the credit is stolen by Karate Master, Liu. To prove himself and win Li back, Yin defeats Liu in the ring with his unique martial arts move "Invincible Wind and Fire Spin".

programme.title: Cruel War
programme.desc: To combat the greenhouse effect, scientist Yan Xin attempts to plant newly developed super rubber seeds on a remote island, hoping to transform it into a thriving new land. Yan Xin's ex-husband decides to accompany her on this perilous journey. As conflicts arise, they encounter the local drug cartel, and a fatal battle is about to begin.

programme.title: Maoshan Heavenly Master
programme.desc: Prisoner Chi flees away under Master Zhang's custody, causing the latter to be expelled from his clan. On his way to find Chi, Master Zhang arrives at a place where many people vanish for no reason. He soon discovers that it is Chi who captures them in his training to become a serpent demon. The war between human and demon has just begun!

programme.title: Love in a Fallen City
programme.desc: Based on a novel of the same name by the famous novelist Eileen Chang and directed by the equally acclaimed director Ann Hui, this romance story depicts the challenging relationship between an introverted Shanghai divorcee and a cynical Malaysian playboy during the Japanese invasion of Hong Kong in the 1940s. Will the lovers be together in the end?

programme.title: Prince Charming
programme.desc: Chen Li Pin, the nerdy son of a business tycoon, and his friend seek love in Hawaii. Returning home in disappointment, they accidentally find themselves in a messy identity swap. It is at this time that Chen falls for a beautiful girl May, who thinks he is a company chauffeur...

programme.title: Unbeatable
programme.desc: Former world champion boxer Fai meets fiery young fighter Qi in Macau. As he mentors Qi for an upcoming MMA tournament, Fai rekindles his passion for fighting, life, and the people he cares about.

programme.title: Unbeatable
programme.desc: Former world champion boxer Fai meets fiery young fighter Qi in Macau. As he mentors Qi for an upcoming MMA tournament, Fai rekindles his passion for fighting, life, and the people he cares about.

programme.title: Mid-night Two
programme.desc: Yi Cheng and his friends venture into a haunted mountain that hides an ancient corpse and an eternal ghostly flame. No one who enters the mountain ever returns and at 2:30 AM, Yi Cheng's friends vanish one by one. While searching for them in the eerie forest, Yi Cheng enters a realm of infinite reincarnation, facing a series of terrifying events...

programme.title: The Story Of My Son
programme.desc: Li attempts to make a fortune at the horse-racing tracks, but is subsequently entangled with loan sharks. Li becomes debt-laden while his sons are harassed by debt collectors, when more heart-wrenching events begin to unfold.

programme.title: God of Gamblers 2
programme.desc: After the God of Gamblers Ko Chun disappears, his disciple Little Knife rises in the gambling world. His fame attracts a ruthless rival who seeks to defeat him. Facing high-stakes games, Little Knife must rely on his skills to overcome his enemies and defend the honour of the God of Gamblers.

programme.title: Sex Beyond The Grave
programme.desc: During World War II, a singer was raped and killed by Master Tao during her escape, with all her valuables stolen as well. Since then, the Tao's house became haunted. Years later, Master Tao's descendant sells the house to a young couple to pay off a massive gambling debt, but the couple soon discover that it is haunted by the vengeful spirit...

programme.title: Mother VS Mother
programme.desc: Guan De Xing fell in love with Li Xiao Yun when he was young, but was opposed by his mother and had to marry Zhou Shen Yu. Since then, Li holds a grudge against Zhou. Unfortunately, the son of Guan and Zhou falls in love with Li's daughter, and as the two mothers meet, they start brawling again!

programme.title: The Gangster, the Cop, the Devil
programme.desc: The movie is adapted from real events. Detective Lin sets up a special unit to arrest the motorbike robber and the crime syndicate behind the thefts in Foshan. In the process, his pregnant wife is hit by a motorbike robber, leading him to uncover their revenge plan...

programme.title: Open the Coffin
programme.desc: Ghost Hand and his tomb raiders resurface in Jiang City to seek gold in ancient tombs after a 3-year absence. They released an evil spirit from a coffin and all four died at home eventually. Poison and pinholes in the corpses become the sole clue for police investigation. A tomb raid now unfolds as a perplexing and mysterious case.

programme.title: Hong Kong Hong Kong
programme.desc: After moving to Hong Kong, illegal immigrant Mang has no choice but to live in cramped quarters with male migrants who abuse her. In order to attain Hong Kong residency and a better life, she agrees to marry a lonely old carpenter. After her marriage, Mang crosses paths again with her ex-lover, and the two develop a passionate affair...

programme.title: The Mighty Peking Man
programme.desc: King Kong comes to Hong Kong in THE MIGTHY PEKING MAN, a uniquely Shaw Brothers spin on the ageless theme of beauty and the beast. The beast, seven stories high and hailing from the Himalayas, makes his way to the jungles of India in the wake of a violent earthquake. The beauty is Russia starlet Evelyne Kraft, a sexy blonde Tarzanette who is the Mighty Peking Man's best friend.

programme.title: Young Ip Man: Crisis Time
programme.desc: Set in 1917, young Ip Man pursues his studies in Hong Kong. The school is held hostage on the day of an English speech competition, and as Ip Man decides to step up and fight the crisis, it is revealed that his master and his childhood friend are behind all this. Can he take them down and uphold justice?

programme.title: The Mad Monk
programme.desc: Stephen Chow plays an arrogant god in Heaven who is being punished for his pranks and mistakes. He is sent to Earth and reincarnate as Mad Monk to change the destiny of three misguided souls - a prostitute, a beggar and a villain. The Mad Monk needs to complete the task in three days in order to return to Heaven.

programme.title: Love Is Love
programme.desc: Shui and Tai are lovers who grew up together in a village but move to the city as Tai's father disapproves of their relationship. Tai secretly works in a nightclub to help finance Shui to get the job of a salesman. When Shui is promoted for his good work and finds himself progressing in his career, he begins to feel distant from Tai...

programme.title: A Man Called Hero
programme.desc: In 1913, a brutal massacre forces Hua into exile in America. Reunited with his pregnant wife, tragedy strikes again when their home burns down on the night she gives birth to twins, killing her while their daughter gets kidnapped. Sixteen years later, as his son finds him, Hua confronts his ultimate nemesis in a climactic duel on top of the Statue of Liberty.

programme.title: Lifeline
programme.desc: A heroic tale about Hong Kong's brave firefighters. These courageous men can march into disastrous firegrounds and risk their lives to save others. However, do they have the same courage to confront their personal issues?

programme.title: I Love Lolanto
programme.desc: Lolanto, a playboy, is injured and meets the daughter of a tycoon, Man, in the hospital. Man is mentally retarded and makes friends easily with Lolanto hence Man's father hires him to take care of her. However, as Man goes through treatments and recovers, her feelings for Lolanto also changes...

programme.title: 3Below: Tales of Arcadia S1 - Lightning in a Bottle

programme.title: 3Below: Tales of Arcadia S1 - The Arcadian Job
programme.desc: When Aja and Krel learn a secret, military base may house an alien spacecraft, they enlist Stuart to help them infilitrate it. Meanwhile, General Morando unviels his latest weapon - Omen, a deadly, cyborg assassin.

programme.title: Fast & Furious: Spy Racers S1 - Bem-Vindo ao Rio
programme.desc: After losing their mission materials in quicksand, Tony decides to channel Dom and Blend in to get intel from the people of Rio. Unfortunately it's more difficult than he expected, and Tony and his crew are picked up by a group of favela gangsters in a neighborhood that worships a mysterious young female martyr. The crew is relieved to find that Layla is in charge of the gangsters - until she orders the gangsters to dispose of them!

programme.title: Fast & Furious: Spy Racers S1 - Combustion
programme.desc: Tony is convinced that Layla is deep undercover and tries to talk to her alone to get through to her. Meanwhile, the crew investigates the gang’s production of the mysterious formula from the tattoo. When Frostee discovers that the product of the formula is unstable and will explode, Tony has to save Layla, who is driving a whole truck of it!

programme.title: Fast & Furious: Spy Racers S1 - Driving Blind
programme.desc: Now broken out of mind control, Layla goes undercover with the gang, hiding the fact that she’s no longer being controlled. The crew is shocked to discover that revered martyr Rafaela Moreno is still alive and is the mastermind behind the mind control plot. Rafaela puts Layla’s driving to the test in a wild race against a mystery driver, then takes the rest of the crew hostage just days before Rafaela's dastardly plot.

programme.title: Fast & Furious: Spy Racers S1 - An Echo of Nowhere
programme.desc: Now in Rafaela’s custody, the crew works together to break Echo out to retrieve the hauler. Echo makes it into the jungle and must battle a mind-controlled Ms. Nowhere using everything she’s learned about spying and survival from the very woman who's out to get her. Meanwhile, Rafaela enlists Frostee to help her develop a non-exploding version of the mind control formula before her plan goes into motion at the favela race.

programme.title: Fast & Furious: Spy Racers S1 - The Patroness
programme.desc: Echo and Ms. Nowhere bust Cisco, Frostee, and Gary out of their cell. But Rafaela has already mind controlled Tony and Layla and taken them to drive for her in the favela race, allowing her to release her mind control formula on the crowd!

programme.title: Dinotrux S2 - Picktools

In his impatience, he does not want to wait for the moon to rise. He wants to see it straight away. Raggety does elf magic to see the moon at once but promptly vanishes. The others think he is playing a trick and hiding from them, bu

Kelp, Pixie, Ollie, and their friend Leroy try to help Juniper understand her angry feelings.

programme.title: Not Quite Narwhal S1 - Tuskist Three Moon Festival
programme.desc: Scallop is afraid of her first “tuskist” appointment. Kelp helps her get through it with a song. Fog rolls in, threatening Kelp’s first Three Moon Festival in Unicorn Land. Kelp and his friends use a combination of unicorn spark and the Kelp Way to create a new festival.

DJ Catnip teaches them a song to remember how to get there and Baby Box helps them make jetpacks so they can zip around. In the Cat-osphere, they take a twirl through Space Swirls and zip through the Supergallactic Doughnut Hole and even meet DJ Catnip's cousin, DJ Comet! For the Cat of the Day Segment, Baby Box and DJ Comet show us how to craft a papier-mâché Caturn.

programme.title: Madagascar: A Little Wild S1 - A Tale of Two Kitties
programme.desc: Alex is mistaken for a Maine Coon and takes over that cat’s life in the penthouse. At first, VERY comfortable with his shmancy new life, Alex grows to miss his old life and learns that it’s lonely at the top.

programme.desc: When Gloria meets a shy hermit crab, named Starlene, with a secret talent of tap dancing, Gloria plans a flashy production for Starlene’s debut so she can share her talent with the world! But with the help of the Gabby Cats, Fluffy learns how to fail fantastically and be the most fluff-tastic version of herself. programme.title: The Real Housewives of Beverly Hills S15 - Hot Girl Summer
programme.desc: Dorit has recently filed for divorce and opens up to the ladies about her ex, their children and if she’s ready for a Hot Girl Summer. Kyle is planning Alexia’s wedding and navigating life with Mauricio. Sutton must reassess her friendships in the group after being cut off by her former bestie. A familiar face makes a fashionable entrance at Kyle’s Summer Solstice Party as Kathy arrives with Rachel Zoe.

programme.title: The Real Housewives of Beverly Hills S15 - Bearing It All
programme.desc: After an evasive conversation at the Summer Solstice party, Boz and Rachel are left wondering about the sincerity of certain friendships. Erika turns to Sutton for support amid a looming lawsuit. Kyle opens up about the ending of her first relationship since separating from her husband. Dorit fights back tears as her divorce takes a toll on her family. New housewife Amanda meets the group at Jennifer Tilly’s racy Sip &amp; Draw party.

programme.title: The Real Housewives of Beverly Hills S15 - A Match Made In Beverly Hills
programme.desc: Boz hosts a speed-dating event where Erika struggles while Kyle discusses her separation. Rachel encourages a post-annulment Sutton to move on, and Dorit seeks financial advice from "Money Queen" Amanda.

programme.title: The Real Housewives of Beverly Hills S15 - A Housewives Heatwave
programme.desc: Sutton plans a Sedona trip to showcase her growth. Kathy’s dinner puts Amanda in the hot seat, while Dorit and Kyle navigate their separations. Boz continues her fertility journey, and Erika reveals a new beau.

programme.title: The Real Housewives of Beverly Hills S15 - Not Feeling The Healing
programme.desc: In Sedona, Kyle and Dorit’s rift persists. While Boz and Rachel struggle with the heat, others hike to a vortex. Amanda shares rumors about Sutton’s ex-assistant, and Jennifer Tilly clashes with Sutton.

programme.title: The Real Housewives of Beverly Hills S15 - Star Signs And Bad Times
programme.desc: Rachel hosts a psychic party where Sutton and Jennifer Tilly face off. Boz pursues fertility treatments in Nevada. Dorit confronts Amanda about her marriage, only to learn of Amanda’s past tragic loss.

programme.title: The Real Housewives of Beverly Hills S15 - Headlines And Heartbreak
programme.desc: After a tearful departure from Rachel's psychic dinner, Amanda turns to Kyle for support while Dorit maintains she's done nothing wrong.

programme.title: Country Spirit - EP14
programme.desc: KOO SAI LUNG (CHUN PUI) is the manager of a wine factory. He adopts his ex-girlfriend’s illegitimate son, SHUNG (LAM KA TUNG), out of kindness. SHUNG is cheerful and tolerates any kind of abuse. LUNG’s sister, YIU (TANG SHUI MAN), loves SHUNG. However, she cannot forget her former love KOU (TSANG WAI KUEN) who is dead.

programme.title: The Driving Power - EP10
programme.desc: MUI (CHENG SIU CHOW, ADAM) is a middle-aged man who has never had a proper job. Throughout his life, he has been relying on his family and living like a playboy. His biggest achievements are marrying a singer, YUNG (YIP TUNG, CECILIA) and raising their daughter CHU (YE MICHELLE). MUI and YUNG love each other very much even after being married for more than 20 years. However, deep down, MUI is still a playboy.

programme.title: Treasure of Destiny - EP22
programme.desc: Pork butcher stall lady boss Chu Ying-kiu (Katy Kung) has innate mystical power. But she is inflicted with some strange illness that causes her to grow a beard. She hopes to find the elixir mentioned in Sutra of Forty-two Chapters for treating her illness. Over the years, university Chinese language professor Cheung King (Moses Chan) has been passionate about finding this legendary treasure. However, he has been suffering from insomnia as he was devastated in an incident.

programme.title: Guts of Man - EP3
programme.desc: TUNG FEI (CHAN KIN FUNG, SAMMUL) ignores his late father’s last will and sneaks out of the Taohua Village, where he grew up, without his sister LAM’s (KOI MING FAI, JOYCE) knowing it. He meets a fisherman’s son SHEUNG FOON (NG CHEUK HAI, RON) on the way. He and FOON travel to the Qiantang River to see the tides. They meet a tycoon’s daughter YING HIU SUET (CHO, MANDY LEE) and FEI falls in love with her at first sight.

programme.title: Brother's Keeper II - EP27
programme.desc: Overcoming adversity, LAW WAI-SHUN (Edwin Siu) and YIU MAN-YING (Kristal Tin) successfully develop the business of Lo Son Kei and make it famous in both Hong Kong and Macau. However, their success upsets a junket promoter-turned-land developer, KO TIN-TSAU (Hugo Ng), who keeps suppressing them. WAI-SHUN is even betrayed by his close confidant TSU CHI-LIK (Mat Yeung).
